Recorded GitHub REST API responses (trimmed to the fields SentinelFlow reads) for
pull requests #1 and #7 of the public synthetic repository
`sukumarmuthusamy/sentinelflow-demo-platform`, captured 2026-11-23 with
unauthenticated read-only GET requests. `contents.json` maps `<sha>:<path>` to the
raw file content at that commit. Used by the offline GitHub change-source tests.
